title: ApplianceStateMessage
description: Topic A: freedriver/v1/{instanceId}/appliances (retain=false, QoS 1). Isolation is instanceId (UUIDv4), not a board and not the MQTT client-id. instanceName is UX only (not in the topic, not in ACLs). applianceName is the alias key. Boards are not on this wire. Schema 2 replaces v1 (never live-commanded).

instanceId.description: Autonomy instance UUIDv4 (8-4-4-4-12). Not the MQTT protocol client-id. Rejects /, +, #.

instanceName.description: UX only (dashboard tab). Never a topic segment. Never in an ACL.
